page.overview:
Who is Blanco Bracegirdle?

Blanco Bracegirdle was a Hobbit of the Shire.

Blanco was the child of unnamed Bracegirdles. He related himself with the Boffin family when he married Primrose Boffin. They had two children: Bruno and Lobelia.
